description: PLANT-03 records unit_price in 万元 (ten-thousands) scale while other plants use 元 (yuan) scale in the same column. 15 out of 90 rows (16.7%) have unit prices in 0.08-0.14 range (万元) versus 800-1400 range (元) for other plants. This represents a 10,000x magnitude difference. The defect creates a bimodal distribution with peaks separated by exactly 10,000x factor, matching the 元/万元 conversion ratio. Affects total_cost_cny calculation and any cross-plant price analysis.
detection_hints: d01-unit-inconsistent skill detects via Step 2 (bimodal distribution) and Step 3 (magnitude difference by dimension). ColumnProfile shows p50/p95/max ratio exceeding 100. Group by plant_code reveals PLANT-03 mean is ~1/10000 of other plants' mean.
